notes.title: 0.9.11b Hotfix Released
notes.notes:
Tents are now can be built and missing "tents" icon is fixed.
Bug causing game to not applying new effects when learning multiple research nodes is fixed.

notes.title: A new update (0.9.11) has been released
notes.notes:
v0.9.11 changelog:
Fixed undead animal bug on combat.
Added frame rate limit in Display Settings.
In events, fixed 0 victim/perpetrator count.
In events, fixed death and sickness responses killing all clan.
Fixed duplicate research bonus bugs after migration.

notes.title: 0.9.10 Update
notes.notes:
v0.9.10 changelog:
Save Game, Load Game and Resume issues are now fixed.
Kill a creature/predator objectives, target creatures are now created dynamically.
Added camping/walking checks for several objectives.
Fixed research tree reset bug on save file changing.

notes.title: Hotfix Released (0.9.9)
notes.notes:
v0.9.9 changelog:
Fixed radial menu not opening bug.
Fixed India, Mesopotamia and Europe objective requirements with correct item, resource and creature kill checks.
Fixed Inventory widget overflow bugs.
Fixed gameplay event response effects and manuel toolip texts.
Increased nutrition levels of complex food recipes.

notes.title: New Update (0.9.8)
notes.notes:
A new update (0.9.8) has been released, we worked on fixing last reported bugs in this update.

v0.9.8 changelog:
In India map, fixed last objective's location to prevent progress blocking bug.
Fixed tooltip formats of random gameplay event effects.
Fixed ListView crash related to Tribe Scene tribemen list.
Fixed missing ability on loading game.
Fixed UI interaction bugs on level success.
Added backup checks for missing crafting recipes on level progress.
Fixed missing research effects bug after migrating.
Changed confusing objective texts in Mesopotamia map.

notes.title: New Hotfix is live! (0.9.7)
notes.notes:
A new update (0.9.7) has been released, we worked on improving the sandbox experience in this update. Critical procedural generation bugs and unit spawn bugs have been fixed! 

v0.9.7 changelog:
In sandbox mode, increased generation of lake tiles and rivers.
In sandbox mode, improved tile generation options to make common tiles more sparse and lesser tile to spawn more.
In sandbox mode, fixed dead animal tile spawning without resources bug.
Fixed double save file bug.
Fixed new clan join in water bug.
Fixed empty crafting inventory bug.
In the advanced tutorial, the predator animal is now spawning dynamically.
Fixed enemy clan disappear on spawning inside a cave.
Fixed enemy clan pointer arrow blocking active objective marker.
Fixed empty inventory bug in the recipe discovering page.

notes.title: New Hotfix Patch!! (0.9.6)
notes.notes:
A new update (0.9.6) has been released, critical bugs have been fixed in this update such as overwritten savefiles and stuck turn issue! 

Your old save files may not be compatible. We didn't have enough save files to test, sadly.

v0.9.6 changelog:
Missing cooked vegetable image added to recipe researching.
Fixed food/ration consume policy not updating bug after restart and/or load.
Changed passive research gain on tile updates.
Fixed unknown inventory item issue in recipe-research section.
Removed cooking items from crafting inventory in recipe-research section.
Fixed end turn lock bug when AI Clan is in sight.
Fixed double AI Clan bug.
Disabled inputs, events and interactions in level fail screen.
Added quickload button to level fail screen.
Fixed save file lost progression errors.
Added more information to load save file screen. (Save Type, Last Map, Creation Date, Turn Count)
Changed objective widget's text alignment. (Working on a general fix, needs more testing.)
Fixed save game file overflow in load game popup.

In the next update, we are going to fix tutorial level bugs and fix the biome distribution in sandbox mode.

notes.title: First hotfix after release
notes.notes:
A new update (0.9.5 ) has been released, in this update we have focused on players' feedback and we have fixed prioritized bugs.

Added resource and item reward texts to responses of Kondoa landmark events and negative gameplay events. 
Fixed formatting of broken event response texts for general gameplay events.
Fixed an issue with research tree that removes known crafting recipes. (Infamous crafting bug mentioned in discussions)
Fixed display settings reverting to default on quit.
Fixed a bug where quality settings were not saving and reverted to default.
Fixed input detection issue when closing the in-game escape menu.
Added missing control checks for the first savanna objectives (resource gathering objectives).
Removed most debug texts used for development.
Restricted tutorial levels to only 4 available achievements.
Re-added the "Make a Camp" achievement.
Added lock-state checks for the objective prompt box camera ping pong button.
Increased the speed of camera in objective ping-pong effect.
Resolved texture streaming pool size issue.

In the next update, we are going to fix autosave and save-load issues. Also we're working on reordering tutorial progression and the difficulty of both tutorial levels.

notes.title: The Ancients Early Access Release Date is Here!!!
notes.notes:
Grab your spears, Tribe!

[h1]Turn-based prehistoric survival strategy, The Ancients, will be releasing to Early Access June 5![/h1]

The Ancients takes the core mechanics of real-time prehistorical survival strategy, Dawn of Man, and brings it to a unique turn-based experience, complete with deep skill tree, diverse wildlife, real Ice Age biomes and increasingly challenging migration routes to keep your survival skills honed.

Check out the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=WOV-mHjClDA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Some Highlights:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A complete tutorial, campaign mode and procedurally generated sandbox mode for infinite replayability are available from Day 1 in the Early Access release
[*] 60+ historically accurate resources & animals to discover, gather & hunt
[*] 75+ research nodes and society paths to boost replayability and diversify your approach to managing your tribe & surviving the harsh Ice Age environments
[*] Needs management mechanics will be familiar to survival fans 
[*] Society management mechanics are new and unique to the genre
[/list]

[h2]Quick Facts:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Early Access Release Date: June 5, 2024
[*] Developer: Small Turkey-based indie studio GorillaSoftworks
[*] Publisher: Camlann Games (Underspace, Ascent of Ashes)
[*] Price: $19.99 (with a 10% launch discount)
[*] Game Modes: Single Player (Campaign Mode & procedurally generated Sandbox Mode)
[*] Discord: https://discord.gg/sKsDGCW6nr
[/list]

See you next month, Tribe!!!

notes.title: New Patch Is Live: 0.8.17
notes.notes:
[h2]New Patch Is Live: 0.8.17[/h2]

Hey Tribe,

New patch is out, we've added some content and fixed some existing issues:

• Added new events and also new options to existing ones.
• Research point gaining is rebalanced to provide easier progression.
• Fixed several creature and clan bugs on save system.
• Fixed climate and weather bugs on loading a save file.
• Research and culture tree requirements and effects changed.
• Added option to save and load game on level ends.
• Added AI Clan to the game.
• Added new vegetables, creatures and trees for new maps Ural, India and SinoChina.
• Added storyline objectives to Ural map.
• Made policy sliders work and connected them to events.
• Changed the nodes under 4 sub branches of culture tree and made them work and selectable.

We are progressing and evolving in preparation for Steam NextFest so catch us October 9 - 16. We will have live content, Dev Q&A, and more!

notes.title: 0.8.11 Update is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello Tribe!

Please report any bugs or issues to our [url=https://discord.gg/HPwH5x7Cbz]Discord[/url]. Thank you!


[b]VERSION 0.8.11[/b]

- Known Save/Load system bugs are fixed
- Known pathfinding bugs resolved
- Known UI bugs resolved
